<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/cli_reference.py from the programs themselves: edit those, not this page. -->

Published model and sorter artifacts: list, info, pull, verify, remove, clean

```text
dspk hub [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## `dspk hub list`

Catalog entries and whether they are downloaded

```text
dspk hub list [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`--family <FAMILY>`**  
  Only this family (e.g. kilosort4)
- **`--installed`**  
  Only downloaded entries

## `dspk hub info`

One entry: source, hash, local path and how to cite it

```text
dspk hub info [OPTIONS] <ID>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<ID>`**

## `dspk hub pull`

Download and verify (size and SHA-256)

```text
dspk hub pull [OPTIONS] <ID>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<ID>`**

**Options**

- **`--force`**  
  Download again even if installed

## `dspk hub verify`

Re-hash downloaded files (all, or one)

```text
dspk hub verify [OPTIONS] [ID]
```

**Arguments**

- **`[ID]`**

**Options**

- **`--check-links`**  
  Also check that the download link answers

## `dspk hub remove`

Delete one downloaded entry

```text
dspk hub remove [OPTIONS] <ID>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<ID>`**

## `dspk hub clean`

Delete every downloaded entry

```text
dspk hub clean [OPTIONS]
```
